Subject: LuminaHealth Q3 dedicated capacity request

Ben —

Quick one: LuminaHealth is finalizing a Q3 pilot that needs dedicated inference capacity for clinical imaging model inference. We just completed SOC 2 and want to lock in committed slots ASAP to meet our go-live window (early September).

Initial ask: 6x A100-80GB equivalent (dedicated), sustained for 9am–6pm PT weekdays; burst to 10x for 2 hours/day during peak ingest. Target start: 2028-08-15.

We’ve attached our requested sizing spreadsheet (LH_Q3_capacity_request.xlsx). Can Redwood confirm availability and a provisional allocation plan by end of day? If capacity is constrained we need a clear escalation path and SLAs for preemption/compensation.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Director, Cloud Ops
LuminaHealth

Attachments: LH_Q3_capacity_request.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

I’ve looped in our account lead (Laura) and infra planning (Markus) to align on a concrete proposal.

- Internal triage (30m) to confirm whether a committed lane is available for 8/15 start.
- Draft a Mutual Action Plan (MMP) with provisional reservation + fallback options (burst credits, queued preempt window).
- We’ll confirm a provisional allocation + expected SLA for preemption compensation by EOD PST.

Holding note: if you can be flexible on exact start date by ±2 weeks it materially improves our options.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.co>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.co, markus_klein@redwood.co
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: LuminaHealth Q3 dedicated capacity request — triage needed

Team —

Forwarding LuminaHealth’s request. TL;DR: 6x A100-80GB equivalent dedicated, burst to 10x for short windows, target start 2028-08-15.

Constraints: we have overlapping commitments to Sunridge Labs and a partially-committed tranche for HelioMed later in August. I want to avoid last-minute preemption for a healthcare customer going to production. Proposed options (ranked):

1) Provisional reserve for LuminaHealth: allocate 6 slots on Dedicated pool D3 with a 4-week contingency hold. Commit start 8/15 conditional on final MMP. Pros: meets their go-live. Cons: reduces headroom for revenue-generating burst deals.

2) Split-commit + burst credits: give 4 dedicated slots guaranteed, allow burst to 10x via cross-customer burst pool with credits and explicit preemption window (we offer credits if preempt <72h notice). Pros: preserves some fleet flexibility.

3) Delay start by up to 2 weeks and offer steep first-month credit + prioritized migration to next patch of freeslots. Pros: less operational strain; risk to customer timeline.

I’ve attached a quick capacity_split_matrix.pdf sketch and a MMP draft (MMP_Lumina_v1.docx). Markus — can you run a quick heatmap (which fleet slices are impacted) and tell us which option keeps us within SLA targets? Laura — what’s the commercial leeway on start date / credits? I’ll hold on communicating back to Alex until we pick an approach.

Attachments: MMP_Lumina_v1.docx (draft), capacity_split_matrix.pdf (sketch)

—Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.co>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@luminamed.com>
Cc: Jade Ross <jade.ross@luminamed.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.co
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth Q3 dedicated capacity request

Alex —

Thanks for the spreadsheet. We ran a quick internal triage and can propose a provisional plan while we finalize the MMP:

Provisional Allocation (subject to MMP signature):
- Guaranteed: 4x A100-80GB equivalent dedicated slots on Dedicated pool D3, reserved 9am–6pm PT weekdays starting 2028-08-17 (two-day buffer from your requested date).
- Burst: up to 10x capacity for two 2-hour daily windows via our burst pool. Burst events are best-effort and have a soft preemption window; in the event of forced preemption we provide service credits (see proposed terms in MMP).
- Contingency: we will hold an additional 2x slots in contingency for 4 weeks; those will be cold-standby and subject to confirmed priority decisions from our Allocation Committee.

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign the attached MMP_Lumina_v1.docx (I attached a link).
2) We’ll schedule a 30m runbook call with infra (provisioning + monitoring) and CS to confirm handoffs.
3) If you can confirm a ±2 week flexibility on start date, we can convert contingency slots to active reserved sooner.

If this aligns I’ll route the MMP to legal for a shortform SOW and mark the allocation as provisional in our capacity system.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: LuminaHealth Q3 dedicated capacity request — triage needed

Ben/Laura —

I ran the quick heatmap. Summary: Dedicated pool D3 can absorb the 4 guaranteed + 2 contingency slots with minor reshuffling if we accept the following mitigations:

- Implement a 14-day preemption notice for Sunridge Labs (they are in a non-critical dev window) and offer a 20% first-month credit if we need to shift their tranche earlier.
- For HelioMed we can preserve their tranche by moving a slice from D2 -> D4 (requires a short config window 8/10–8/12).

Operational asks:
- CS (Laura) to confirm LuminaHealth signs MMP within 72h of provisional allocation or contingency slots are released.
- Sales (Ben) to confirm commercial credit terms (we should aim for 10–20% first-month credit on contingency conversion).

Recommendation: go with option 2 (Split-commit + burst credits) as the default public-facing plan. It balances customer timeline with fleet flexibility and gives us contractual levers to reduce exposure. I’ll start the reconfiguration ticket (infra-TKT-9981) and tag it high-priority.

Markus Klein
Senior Infra Planner, Redwood Inference
